_comment: What a village and a city offer (asked by Adrien: a village is small, a city has everything). inn: écus for a night (life back in full). sells: what the merchant has. buys: share of an item's price paid when the explorer sells it (food and what was gathered). forge: weapons sold by the smith. tavern: rumours heard there (ids, texts in i18n: rumor.<id>), one at a time, changing every half hour.
